title: Maggie and the Little Water Pump
moral: With patience and courage, problems can be solved.

scenes.summary: Maggie rides her horse Star and checks the ranch water pump.
scenes.text: Maggie rides at dawn with her horse Star and checks the water pump that the ranch needs.
scenes.image_prompt: young cowgirl with horse near water pump at sunrise, colorful cartoon children's book style
scenes.story: Maggie rides her horse Star at dawn across the wide prairie. She looks after the ranch and checks the water pump every day. The ranch needs water for calves and flowers. One morning the pump does not work. Maggie stays calm and uses her tools. She finds a pebble stuck inside and fixes it. Water flows again and everyone is happy. Later a storm comes and shakes the ranch. Maggie keeps the pump safe and ties it strong. Neighbors come to help and they work together. After the storm the sun shines again. Maggie waters everything and rests. She feels proud because she helped and kept the ranch safe.
